भग, अस्, m. a liberal or wealthy master (‘ap-
portioner of food’), gracious lord, patron (a frequent
epithet of Savitṛ, Ved.); N. of an Āditya (regarded
in the Veda as bestowing wealth, and instituting or
presiding over love and marriage; he is brother of
the Dawn, and the afternoon is peculiarly sacred to
him; his Nakṣatra is the Uttara-Phalgunī, considered
particularly favourable for forming alliances by mar-
riage; according to a legend his eyes were destroyed by
Rudra; Yāska enumerates him among the divinities
of the highest sphere); N. of the sun; of the moon;
of a Rudra; good fortune, happiness, happy lot,
prosperity, affluence [cf. दुर्-भ्˚, सु-भ्˚]; dignity,
majesty, distinction; beauty, loveliness; excellence;
amorous pleasure, dalliance; love, affection; the
pudenda (pudendum muliebre); (अम्), n. the Nak-
ṣatra called Uttara-Phalgunī; the perinæum of
males; a term applied to a Muhūrta; (according to
native lexicographers) = यत्न, प्रयत्न, कीर्त्ति,
यशस्, वैराग्य, इच्छा, ज्ञान, मुक्ति, मोक्ष,
धर्म, स्त्री; (अस्, आ or ई, अम्), at the end of
comps., see Gaṇa Bahv-ādi to Pāṇ.

; [cf.

‘slayer of Bhaga,’ an epithet of Śiva.

fortune.
—भग-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a prince of
Prāg-jyotiṣa; of a king of Kāmrūp.
—भग-दा,
f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
—भग-देव, अस्, m. ‘whose god is the female

अस्, आ, अम्, having Bhaga for a deity; (आ), f. a

having Bhaga for a deity; conferring conjugal feli-

अक्˚), आ, m. ‘destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga,’ an

भाग 1. भाग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. भज्), a part,
portion, share, lot, division, allotment, partition,
distribution [cf. दाय-भ्˚]; portioning out; good
portion, fortunate lot, good fortune, luck, destiny
(Ved.); a fraction, part of any whole, a part of a
whole (e. g. शत-भ्˚, the hundredth part); a quarter
(in एक-भ्˚, one fourth; त्रि-भ्˚, three fourth); part
of anything given as interest; the numerator of a
fraction; a division of time, the thirtieth part of a
Rāśi or zodiacal sign; a degree or 360th part of the
circumference of a great circle; a quotient; a half
rupee; place, spot, region, side, border; N. of a
king, (also भागवत); N. of one of the branches
of the river Candra-bhāgā, q. v.; (अस्, आ, अम्), taking
the place of any one, representing, (at the end of
adj. comps., cf. भाजन); (अम्), n., N. of a parti-
cular Sāman.
—भाग-कल्पना, f. the allotment of
shares.
—भाग-जाति, इस्, f. assimilation of fractions,
reduction of fractions to a common denominator;
[cf. अंश-सवर्णन.]
—भागजाति-चतुष्टय,
अम्, n. four modes of assimilation of fractions or of
reducing them to a common denominator.
—भा-
[]
गञ्-जय, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—भाग-दा, आस्,
आस्, अम्, Ved. granting or giving a share.
—भाग-
दुघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. yielding or dealing out
portions, distributing.
—भाग-ध, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. paying a share, discharging or paying what is
due.
—भाग-धेय, अम्, n. share, portion, part,
lot, portion allotted by destiny, luck, fortune, fate,
destiny; property; happiness; (अस्), m. revenue,
tax, dues, impost; one to whom a share is due, an
heir, co-heir; (अस्, ई, अम्), Ved. due as a share or
part.
—भाग-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, having a share in (any-
thing), interested, a partner.
—भाग-भुज्, क्, m.
‘enjoying taxes,’ a king, sovereign.
—भाग-मातृ,
ता, f. a particular rule of division.
—भाग-मुख,
अस्, m., N. of a man.
—भाग-लक्षणा, f. (in
rhetoric) insinuation or intimation of a part.
—भा-
ग-विज्ञेय, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—भाग-वृत्ति,
इस्, f., N. of a work.
—भागवृत्ति-कार, अस्, m., N.
of an author mentioned in the Prauḍha-mano-ramā.
—भाग-शस्, ind. in parts or portions, according to
a share or portion; one part after another, by turns,
alternately; by and by.
—भाग-हर, अस्, आ, अम्,
taking a part, sharing; (अस्), m. a co-heir; (in
arithmetic) division.
—भाग-हार, अस्, m. (in
arithmetic) division; [cf. भाजन, छेदन.]
—भाग-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, inheriting; (ई), m. an
heir.
—भागानुबन्ध-जाति (˚ग-अन्˚), इस्, f. assi-
milation of quantities by fractional increase; reduc-
tion of quantities to uniformity by the addition of a
fraction.
—भागापहार-जाति (˚ग-अप्˚), इस्, f. assi-
milation of quantities by fractional decrease, reduction
of quantities to uniformity by the subtraction of a
fraction.
—भागार्थिन् (˚ग-अर्˚), ई, इनी, इ, desirous
of a share (as of a sacrifice).
—भागार्ह (˚ग-अर्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, entitled to a portion or inheritance; to
be divided according to shares.
—भागासुर (˚ग-
अस्˚), अस्, m., N. of an Asura.
—भागी-कृ, cl. 8. P.
A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to divide, share.

personages; frequently found in the voc. भगवन्
[Ved. भगवस् and भगोस्, see Vārttika II. to

, Vopa-deva

, where भगोस्, like अघोस् and भोस्, is
said to drop the final स् before all vowels and all soft
consonants] as a respectful mode of address, and also
similarly used in the Veda in the nom. with the 3rd
sing. of the verb; with Buddhists भग-वत् is
respectfully prefixed to the titles of their sacred
writings); (आन्), m. ‘the holy one,’ ‘the revered
one,’ a deity, a god; an epithet of Viṣṇu; of Śiva;

आभ्˚), अम्, n., N. of an artificial style of writing.

—भगवद्-उपनयन, अम्, n., N. of

—भगवद्-गीता, f. (उप-
निषद् being sometimes supplied, or in the fem. pl.
भगवद्-गीता उपनिषदस्), ‘the mystical doctrine
sung or declared by Bhagavat, i. e. Kṛṣṇa,’ N. of
a celebrated episode of the great epic poem called
Mahā-bhārata, (it is really a comparatively modern
philosophical poem interpolated in the Bhīṣma-parva
and generally divided into eighteen chapters com-
mencing at 1. 830, or the twenty-fifth chapter of the
[]
Bhīṣma-p., and ending at 1. 1532; it is in the form
of a dialogue between Kṛṣṇa, acting as Arjuna's
charioteer, and Arjuna himself, in which the Pan-
theism of the Vedānta with a tinge of the Sāṅkhya
is combined with the later principle of भक्ति or
devotion to Kṛṣṇa as the Supreme Being, Arjuna
being therein admonished that the renunciation of
the world ought not to involve the avoidance of
action or the neglect of professional duties); (अम्),
n. that which is sung or proclaimed by Kṛṣṇa.
—भगवद्गीता-गूढार्थ-दीपिका (˚ढ-अर्˚), f.,
N. of a metrical commentary on the Bhagavad-gītā

व-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a metrical commentary

—भगवन्ना-
मकौमुदी-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a metrical
commentary by Ananta-deva on the preceding work.
—भगवन्नाम-माहात्म्य-ग्रन्थ-सङ्ग्रह,
अस्, m., N. of a metrical composition by Raghunā-
thendra Yati on the merit of repeating the name
of the Deity.
—भगवन्-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, wholly
devoted to Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.

—भग्नाश (˚न-आश्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, one whose hopes or expectations are broken,
disappointed in expectation, discouraged.
—भग्नोत्-
साह (˚न-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose energy is
impaired, broken in energy.
—भग्नोद्यम (˚न-
उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose efforts are frustrated,
baffled in one's endeavours, frustrated.
—भग्नोरु-
दण्ड (˚न-ऊरु-), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘broken-thighed,’

भग्नी भग्नी. See p. 696, col. 3.
भग्नी, f. = भगिनी, a sister.

भगवदीय, अस्, m. a worshipper of Bhagavat,
i. e. of Viṣṇu; [cf. भवदीय.]

भगवन्त or भगवन्त-देव, अस्, m., N.
of a prince, the son of Sāhi-deva and a patron of
Nīla-kaṇṭha.
—भगवन्त-भास्कर, N. of a
work; [cf. भगवद्-भास्कर.]
भगस्, अस्, n., Ved. = भग, q. v.
भगिनिका, f. a little sister.
भगिनी, f. See under भगिन् above.
भगिनीय, अस्, m. (probably) a sister's son.

भगीरथ, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. भगिन् + रथ),
N. of an ancient king (son of Dilīpa and great-grand-
son of Sagara, king of Ayodhyā; he brought down
the sacred Gaṅgā from heaven to earth by the aid
of Śiva, who is fabled to have received the stream
on his head; he then conducted this river to the
ocean, in order to purify the ashes of his ancestors,
the 60,000 sons of Sagara, who were reduced to
ashes by Viṣṇu in the form of Kapila when they
dug through the earth, then under his protection,
in seeking to recover the sacrificial horse which had
[]
been stolen from their father, see Rāmāyaṇa

44); N. of a commentator on the Amara-kośa and
author of the metrical commentary Nyāya-līlāvatī-

—भगीरथ-प्रयत्न, अस्, m. ‘Bha-
gīratha's labour,’ a term for any Herculean effort or

—भगीरथ-सुता, f. ‘daughter of Bhagī-
ratha,’ an epithet of Gaṅgā or the Ganges.
—भ-
गीरथोपाख्यान (˚थ-उप्˚), अम्, n., N. of the

भागीरथ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भगीरथ), relating
to Bhagīratha; (ई), f. a N. of the Ganges; also of
one of the three main streams or branches of the
Ganges, viz. the great western branch; [cf. नव-
द्वीप.]
—भागीरथ-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
place of pilgrimage.
भागीरथ भागीरथ. See col. 1.
भगोस्. See भग-वत्, col. 1.

भागक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of an adj. comp.)
= 1. भाग, q. v., sharing, dividing; (अस्), m. (?),
a divisor (in arithmetic).

भागवत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भग-वत्), relating
to or coming from Bhaga-vat, i. e. Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa;
worshipping Bhaga-vat; holy, sacred, divine; (अस्),
m. a follower of Bhaga-vat, worshipper of Viṣṇu
or Kṛṣṇa; N. of a king.
—भागवत-तात्पर्य,
अम्, n., N. of a work by Ānanda-tīrtha or Madhu.
—भागवत-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of the most
celebrated and popular of the eighteen Purāṇas,
especially dedicated to the glorification of Viṣṇu,
(it was narrated by Śuka, son of Vyāsa, to king
Parīkṣit, grandson of Arjuna, who in consequence
of a hermit's curse had been bitten by as snake, and
desired to die with his thoughts fixed on Viṣṇu;
the tenth book, which is the most characteristic and
best known part of the Purāṇa, is devoted to the
history of Kṛṣṇa.)
—भागवत-भावार्थ-दी-
पिका (˚व-अर्˚), f., N. of a commentary by Śrī-
dhara on the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa.
—भागवत-लीला-
रहस्य, अम्, n., N. of a work.
—भागवत-सन्-
दर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a work.
—भागवत-सार-
समुच्चय, अस्, m. (perhaps) N. of a collection of
the works of Vallabha.
—भागवतामृत (˚त-
अम्˚), अम्, n., N. of a work.

भागवति, इस्, m. (probably) a patronymic from
Bhaga-vat.

भागवित्त, आस्, m. pl. the pupils or followers of
Bhāgavittika.

भागवित्तायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhā-
gavitti.

भागवित्ति, इस्, m., Ved. a patronymic from Bha-
gavitta; N. of a son of Kuthumi.

भागवित्तिक, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhā-
gavitti.

भागवित्तिकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or coming
from Bhāgavittika.

भागिक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a part; forming
one part; having a part; fractional; bearing interest,
subject to a fractional deduction for interest, (भागि-
कं शतम्, one part in a hundred, i. e. one per
cent; भागिका विंशतिः, one part in twenty, i. e.
five per cent); (अस्), m., N. of a man.

भागिनेय, अस्, m. (fr. भगिनी), a sister's son;
(ई), f. a sister's daughter.

भागीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of भागिन्), hav-
ing a larger share, entitled to a larger share.

1. भाग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. भग), relating to
Bhaga; (with युग) the twelfth or last lustrum in
Jupiter's cycle of sixty years; (अम्), n., scil. भ or
नक्षत्र, the asterism of Bhaga or = the seven-
teenth asterism or latter Phalgunī (see नक्षत्र).

2. भाग्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. भाग or fr. rt. भज्),
to be shared, to be divided, divisible (= भज्य);
entitled to a share; = भागिक, forming a part, sub-
ject to a fractional deduction (e. g. भाग्यं शतम्,
one for a hundred, one in a hundred, one per cent);
lucky, fortunate [cf. निर्-भ्˚]; (अम् or आनि), n. sing.
or plur. good or bad fortune (resulting from merit or
demerit in former existences); lot, luck, fate, destiny,
fortune; happiness, welfare; sensual pleasure (?);
(एन), ind. by good fortune, fortunately, happily.
—भाग्य-क्रमेण, ind. in course of fortune.
—भाग्य-भाव, अस्, m. state of fortune.
—भा-
ग्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having good qualities, possess-
ing good fortune, fortunate; happy, prosperous.
—भाग्यवत्-ता, f. fortunateness, good fortune.
—भाग्य-वशात्, ind. from the force or influence
of destiny, through the will of fate, through fortune.
—भाग्य-वृत्ति, इस्, f. course or state of fortune,
destiny.
—भाग्योदय (˚य-उद्˚), अस्, m. rise or
dawn of fortune, commencement of good fortune,
rising prosperity.

भागलक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or coming
from Bhagala.

भागलि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Bhagala; N.
of a preceptor.
भागलेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhāgali.
